title: Bay Venture Boat Rentals
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: When you rent from Bay Venture Boat Rentals, we give you the keys to your own pontoon boat. Power boating experience is required, but a boater's education/license is not. Feel free to cruise the inland waters of Virginia Beach including, Linkhorn Bay, Broad Bay, Crystal Lake, Long Creek, and the Lynnhaven Inlet. Pull up to the beach. Enjoy watersports like tubing. Grab a bite from several on the water restaurants.
